name: App Runner
description: Run the project's web app(s) from inside the board: a dashboard view to build/start/stop them, health checks, log tail, and a live preview iframe. An agent skill discovers how each project is run and documents it as .app-runner/apps.json + .app-runner/apps.md in the repo.

skills.description: Discover how to build/run this project's app(s), verify a real start against the health endpoint, and write .app-runner/apps.json + .app-runner/apps.md.

views.label: App Runner
views.description: Build/start/stop the project's apps, health status, log tail, and a live preview.

scripts.name: status
scripts.label: Status
scripts.description: Read-only: is .app-runner/apps.json present and valid, and which apps does it declare.

scripts.name: selftest
scripts.label: Self-test
scripts.description: Offline self-test: boots the dashboard against a temp fixture app, starts/stops it through the API.
